LOGBOOK

Notes from the Checkpoint64 team.

  • 📌 Pinned

    Add your own game; Checkpoint64 will back up a save it's never heard of. Version 1.1.0 available now

    2026-08-16

    Every catalog has an edge, and the games at that edge are the ones nobody backs up. The latest version lets you point any game at your own save folder, and add games we don't stock at all — name, folder, done. Plus 28 Ubisoft Connect titles and a second way into a Steam-only account.
  • 📌 Pinned

    Ditch the dedicated server; your co-op group is probably paying for empty hours

    2026-05-20

    A 24/7 rented box is great when ten people play every night. For the average co-op group, it's $120–$240 a year of idle uptime. Here's the math, and how Checkpoint64 covers ~90% of the use case for a one-time payment.

  • Co-op World Ownership Guide for PC Crews

    2026-09-10

    Use this co-op world ownership guide to stop host hostage drama, hand worlds over safely, and keep rollback-ready saves when any PC session goes badly.

  • Gaming Preservation Is Save-File Self-Defence

    2026-09-09

    Gaming preservation means keeping your saves, mods and shared worlds playable after crashes, bad updates and one disastrous overwrite without the drama.

  • How to Undo Accidental Game Overwrites Safely

    2026-09-08

    Undo accidental game overwrites without losing more progress. Learn where saves hide, when recovery works, and how version history prevents the next disaster.
